premise: At bedtime Raccoon isn't sleepy at all; a little cloud slides over the moon and away, and he is sure the moon is playing peekaboo, so he plays back, Hedgehog and Firefly join in, and the game itself — paws over his eyes — carries him off to sleep.
inspiration: The folk moon-that-follows-you motif, turned into a game of peekaboo that ends in sleep.
lesson: Bedtime comes gently, even to the one who isn't sleepy.

en-US.title: Raccoon Plays Peekaboo with the Moon
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] The moon was up, round and bright. It was bedtime, but {raccoon:enter} Raccoon was wide awake. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} "Hello, moon!" {canvas:clouds 0.6} Then a little cloud drifted over it. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] The moon was gone! {raccoon:live look-around} "Where did it go?" {canvas:clouds stop} The cloud drifted by… and there it was again. Peekaboo! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] The moon was playing peekaboo! So Raccoon played back. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} He hid his eyes behind his paws. "Where's Raccoon?" {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} "BOO!" His giggles brought {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to raccoon} Hedgehog snuffling up, {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live laugh} and he laughed and laughed. Then {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to raccoon} Firefly came drifting down to play. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} Her light went bright… then dim. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Blink, blink! Peekaboo! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Everyone giggled. Then Hedgehog gave a yawn. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live curl hold} He curled up into a ball, still smiling. [whispers] "One more," said Raccoon, {raccoon:face sleeping} very sleepily. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} He hid his eyes… and this time he didn't peek out. He was fast asleep. And the moon? [softly] It peeked down at them all night long.

es-ES.title: Cucú-tras con la luna
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] La luna había salido, redonda y brillante. Era hora de dormir, pero {raccoon:enter} Mapache estaba despiertísimo. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} —¡Hola, luna! {canvas:clouds 0.6} Entonces una nubecita pasó por delante. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] ¡La luna había desaparecido! {raccoon:live look-around} —¿Dónde se ha metido? {canvas:clouds stop} La nubecita siguió su camino… y allí estaba otra vez. ¡Tras! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] ¡La luna estaba jugando al cucú-tras! Así que Mapache jugó también. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Se tapó los ojos con las patas. —Cucú… ¿dónde está Mapache? {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} ¡TRAS! Con tanta risa llegó {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to raccoon} Erizo, olisqueando, {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live laugh} y se rió y se rió. Luego {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to raccoon} Luciérnaga bajó volando a jugar. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} Su luz se encendía… y se apagaba. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} ¡Cucú, tras! ¡Cucú, tras! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Todos se partían de risa. Entonces Erizo bostezó. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live curl hold} Se hizo una bola, todavía sonriendo. [whispers] —Otra vez —dijo Mapache, {raccoon:face sleeping} medio dormido. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Se tapó los ojos… y esta vez ya no se destapó. Se había quedado dormido. ¿Y la luna? [softly] Se pasó la noche entera asomada, mirándolos dormir.

ja-JP.title: お月さまと いないいないばあ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:night 0.8}{sfx:crickets}[softly]まあるいお月さまが、ぴかぴか。もうねるじかんなのに、{raccoon:enter}アライグマくんは、目がぱっちり。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:hop}「こんばんは、お月さま！」 {canvas:clouds 0.6}そこへ、小さなくもがふわり。{raccoon:face surprised}[gasps]お月さまが、きえちゃった！{raccoon:live look-around}「どこいったの？」 {canvas:clouds stop}くもがながれていくと…ほら、また見えた。ばあ！{raccoon:face happy}[giggles]お月さまが、いないいないばあをしているんだ！それなら、アライグマくんも。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}りょうてで目をかくして、「いないいない…」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「ばあ！」 そのわらいごえに、{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to raccoon}ハリネズミくんが、ふんふんやってきて、{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:live laugh}けらけらけら。それから{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to raccoon}ホタルさんも、ふわふわおりてきました。{firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A}光が、ぽうっとついて…すうっときえて。{firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}ぴかっ、ぴかっ！いないいないばあ！{raccoon:hop}{hedgehog:wobble}みんな、くすくす。やがて、ハリネズミくんがあくびをひとつ。{hedgehog:face sleeping}{hedgehog:live curl hold}にこにこしたまま、まあるくなりました。[whispers]「もういっかい」 と、{raccoon:face sleeping}ねむそうなアライグマくん。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}目をかくして…こんどは「ばあ」 がありません。ぐっすりねむってしまったのです。そしてお月さまは？[softly]ひとばんじゅう、そっとみんなをのぞいていましたよ。

de-DE.title: Kuckuck, lieber Mond!
de-DE.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] Der Mond stand am Himmel, rund und hell. Es war Schlafenszeit, aber {raccoon:enter} der Waschbär war hellwach. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} „Hallo, Mond!“ {canvas:clouds 0.6} Da schob sich eine kleine Wolke vor den Mond. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] Der Mond war weg! {raccoon:live look-around} „Wo ist er denn hin?“ {canvas:clouds stop} Die Wolke zog weiter… und da war er wieder. Kuckuck! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] Der Mond spielte Kuckuck! Also spielte der Waschbär mit. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Er hielt sich die Pfoten vor die Augen. „Wo ist der Waschbär?“ {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} „KUCKUCK!“ Das Gekicher lockte {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to raccoon} den Igel herbei, schnuff, schnuff, {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live laugh} und er lachte und lachte. Dann schwebte {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to raccoon} das Glühwürmchen herab, um mitzuspielen. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} Sein Licht ging hell an… und wieder aus. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Blink, blink! Kuckuck! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Alle kicherten. Dann gähnte der Igel. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live curl hold} Er rollte sich zu einer Kugel zusammen und lächelte dabei. [whispers] „Noch einmal“, sagte der Waschbär {raccoon:face sleeping} ganz verschlafen. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Er hielt sich die Augen zu… und diesmal guckte er nicht mehr hervor. Er war fest eingeschlafen. Und der Mond? [softly] Der guckte die ganze Nacht lang zu ihnen herunter.

fr-FR.title: Coucou, la lune !
fr-FR.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] La lune s’était levée, toute ronde et toute brillante. C’était l’heure de dormir, mais {raccoon:enter} Raton laveur était bien réveillé. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} « Bonsoir, la lune ! » {canvas:clouds 0.6} Puis un petit nuage est passé devant elle. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] Plus de lune ! {raccoon:live look-around} « Mais où est-elle partie ? » {canvas:clouds stop} Le nuage a continué son chemin… et la revoilà ! Coucou ! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] La lune jouait à coucou-caché ! Alors Raton laveur a joué, lui aussi. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Il s’est caché les yeux derrière ses pattes. « Caché ! Où est Raton laveur ? » {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} « COUCOU ! » Ses éclats de rire ont attiré {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to raccoon} Hérisson, qui est arrivé en reniflant, {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live laugh} et qui a ri, ri, ri. Puis {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to raccoon} Luciole est descendue tout doucement pour jouer. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} Sa lumière s’est allumée… puis éteinte. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Coucou ! Caché ! Coucou ! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Tout le monde riait. Puis Hérisson a bâillé. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live curl hold} Il s’est roulé en boule, en souriant encore. [whispers] « Encore une fois », a dit Raton laveur, {raccoon:face sleeping} tout ensommeillé. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Il s’est caché les yeux… et cette fois, il n’a pas regardé. Il dormait à poings fermés. Et la lune ? [softly] Elle leur a fait coucou toute la nuit.

it-IT.title: Procione fa cucù con la luna
it-IT.text: {canvas:night 0.8} {sfx:crickets} [softly] La luna era alta, tonda e luminosa. Era ora di dormire, ma {raccoon:enter} Procione era sveglissimo. {raccoon:face happy} {raccoon:hop} «Ciao, luna!» {canvas:clouds 0.6} Poi una nuvoletta le è passata davanti. {raccoon:face surprised} [gasps] La luna era sparita! {raccoon:live look-around} «Dov'è andata?» {canvas:clouds stop} La nuvoletta è scivolata via… ed eccola di nuovo. Cucù! {raccoon:face happy} [giggles] La luna giocava a cucù settete! Così Procione ha giocato con lei. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Si è coperto gli occhi con le zampe. «Dov'è Procione?» {raccoon:live peekaboo resume} «SETTETE!» Con tutte quelle risate, è arrivato {hedgehog:enter} {hedgehog:go to raccoon} Riccio, annusando qua e là, {hedgehog:face happy} {hedgehog:live laugh} e si è messo a ridere a crepapelle. Poi {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to raccoon} Lucciola è scesa in volo a giocare. {firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A} La sua luce si è accesa… poi si è affievolita. {firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A} {sfx:twinkle} Accesa, spenta… cucù settete! {raccoon:hop} {hedgehog:wobble} Tutti ridevano. Poi Riccio ha sbadigliato. {hedgehog:face sleeping} {hedgehog:live curl hold} Si è chiuso a palla, ancora sorridente. [whispers] «Ancora una volta», ha detto Procione, {raccoon:face sleeping} mezzo addormentato. {raccoon:live peekaboo hold} Si è coperto gli occhi… e stavolta non ha più sbirciato. Dormiva della grossa. E la luna? [softly] Ha fatto capolino su di loro per tutta la notte.

zh-TW.title: 浣熊和月亮躲貓貓
zh-TW.text: {canvas:night 0.8}{sfx:crickets}[softly]月亮出來了，圓圓的，亮亮的。該睡覺了，可是{raccoon:enter}浣熊一點也不睏。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:hop}「月亮，你好！」 {canvas:clouds 0.6}這時，一朵小雲飄過去，把月亮遮住了。{raccoon:face surprised}[gasps]月亮不見了！{raccoon:live look-around}「月亮跑到哪裡去了？」 {canvas:clouds stop}小雲飄呀飄，飄走了……月亮又出來了。在這裡！{raccoon:face happy}[giggles]原來月亮在跟牠玩躲貓貓！於是，浣熊也跟月亮玩。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}牠用手掌蒙住眼睛。「浣熊不見了……」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「在這裡！」 牠的笑聲，引來了{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to raccoon}刺蝟，鼻子嗅呀嗅的，{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:live laugh}也跟著笑個不停。接著，{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to raccoon}螢火蟲也飛下來一起玩。{firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A}牠的光亮了起來……又暗了下去。{firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}一閃，一閃！不見了，在這裡！{raccoon:hop}{hedgehog:wobble}大家都咯咯笑。後來，刺蝟打了一個呵欠。{hedgehog:face sleeping}{hedgehog:live curl hold}牠縮成一顆球，臉上還笑笑的。[whispers]「再一次就好。」 浣熊說，{raccoon:face sleeping}眼睛都快睜不開了。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}牠蒙住眼睛……這一次，牠沒有再偷看。牠睡著了。那月亮呢？[softly]月亮一整晚，都在偷偷看著牠們。

zh-HK.title: 浣熊和月亮捉迷藏
zh-HK.text: {canvas:night 0.8}{sfx:crickets}[softly]月亮出來了，又圓又亮。已經是睡覺的時間，可是{raccoon:enter}浣熊一點睡意也沒有。{raccoon:face happy}{raccoon:hop}「哈囉，月亮！」 {canvas:clouds 0.6}這時，一朵小雲飄過來，遮住了月亮。{raccoon:face surprised}[gasps]月亮不見了！{raccoon:live look-around}「月亮去咗邊呀？」 {canvas:clouds stop}小雲慢慢飄走……月亮又出來了，好像在說：「喺度！」 {raccoon:face happy}[giggles]原來月亮在跟牠捉迷藏！於是浣熊也跟月亮玩。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}牠用手掩住眼睛。「唔見咗浣熊喇……」 {raccoon:live peekaboo resume}「喺度！」 牠的笑聲，引來了{hedgehog:enter}{hedgehog:go to raccoon}刺蝟。刺蝟嗅呀嗅地走過來，{hedgehog:face happy}{hedgehog:live laugh}也笑個不停。接着，{firefly:enter}{firefly:go to raccoon}螢火蟲也飛下來一起玩。{firefly:glow 1 2s #FFE27A}牠的光亮起來……又暗下去。{firefly:glow 1 0.4s x2 #FFE27A}{sfx:twinkle}一閃，一閃！唔見咗……喺度！{raccoon:hop}{hedgehog:wobble}大家都咯咯地笑。後來，刺蝟打了個呵欠。{hedgehog:face sleeping}{hedgehog:live curl hold}牠縮成一個圓碌碌的刺球，還在笑呢。[whispers]「再玩多次……」 浣熊說，{raccoon:face sleeping}眼睛快要張不開了。{raccoon:live peekaboo hold}牠掩住眼睛……這一次，牠沒有再偷看。牠睡着了。那月亮呢？[softly]月亮一整晚，都在天上偷偷望着牠們。

crickets.prompt: gentle night crickets in a summer meadow, very calm and soft, realistic field recording

twinkle.prompt: two tiny soft twinkles, like a little light blinking on and off, playful
